note: Engine cases for defaults.l4, the TYPICALLY exhibit.
Every case SUPPLIES every input, and that is the point: a DMN model has no
default for an inputData, a BKM parameter or an itemComponent, so the only
honest question to put to it is the one where nothing is left out. What
happens when something IS left out is not asked here; it is the engines'
own behaviour and is pinned once, by name, in
name is null; KIE: a model error, the decision SKIPPED). The exporter's
D-TYPICALLY note says exactly that, and cites it.
The two cases differ in every default: B supplies the opposite of each
TYPICALLY (capacity FALSE, rate 5, timeout 10), so a model that quietly
substituted the source's default for a supplied value would answer A's
`the_band` is the one decision that lowers to a decision TABLE (an `income` input column), so it is the only one dmn-md can draw; its input carries the fourth default.
